note: These are simple predefined forecasting methods, not trained neural networks or AI-generated trading models. Results come from reference/demo_model.mjs on synthetic parcel counts.

models.name: Previous observation
models.recipe: Use the previous day count as the next one-day estimate.
models.createdBy: Pack author; not an agent run

models.name: Trailing three mean
models.recipe: Use the arithmetic mean of the three immediately preceding observed counts.
models.createdBy: Pack author; not an agent run

scope: Baseline v1 fixture catalogue only. Current views after data changes must use the current reducer result, not these scores.
